children: Ethan Allen Interiors has launched a search for a new chief executive to succeed Farooq Kathwari at the helm of the furniture maker.

Ethan Allen on Monday said it has hired an executive search firm that is identifying and evaluating internal and external candidates, adding that its board has committed to announcing a new CEO by June 30, 2027, the date on which Kathwari's current contract is scheduled to end.

The move comes shortly after investor Doug Bergeron, who owns a more than 5% stake in Ethan Allen and has launched a proxy battle for control of the Danbury, Conn., company's board, said he had launched his own search for a potential new CEO.

Bergeron cited the Ethan Allen board's "apparent unwillingness to address the need for a CEO succession," and referenced Kathwari's statement in an August television interview that the board has never raised the issue.
Kathwari, 82 years old, is Ethan Allen's largest shareholder and has been chairman and CEO since 1988.
Ethan Allen, which usually holds its annual shareholder meeting in early November, hasn't yet set a date for this year's gathering.
The company said Kathwari will remain as a nonexecutive member of the board after June 30, and that he will step down from that role at the 2027 annual meeting.
